# technitium_server_info (Data Source)

Read-only information about the Technitium server, e.g. to gate configuration on its version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_server_info" "this" {}

output "technitium_version" {
  value = data.technitium_server_info.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cluster_initialized` (Boolean) Whether clustering is initialized.
- `server_domain` (String) Domain name the server identifies itself with.
- `started_at` (String) Time the server started (RFC 3339).
- `version` (String) Server version, e.g. `15.6.2`.
